Hi Casey,

I just wanted to follow up after speaking with the team, and I can confidently say we would absolutely LOVE to have you come aboard with The Luxora Collective.

After our conversation, everyone really feels like your background, leadership experience, aesthetic knowledge, personality, and sales ability align so naturally with what we are building. It honestly feels like such an organic fit.

I especially love that you already understand the med spa world from the inside out because that is something you simply cannot teach overnight. Your ability to connect with people, understand owners’ pain points, and communicate from real experience is incredibly valuable to us as we continue scaling.

I also think your long-term vision, entrepreneurial mindset, and passion for leadership and growth fit perfectly into the future evolution of the company. We are building something much bigger than just a traditional agency, and I truly think you could become a huge part of that journey with us.

While we continue ramping up our setter team and filling calendars, we would also absolutely love any support you’d be willing to give on the front-end setting side initially, just so we can continue building momentum together while the rest of the systems and team scale into place.

Would love to hear your thoughts after reviewing everything and talking it over with Rachel. No pressure at all, but we are genuinely very excited about the possibility of bringing you into this tight-knit little family we are building.

Talk soon, girl 💛

Bethany

Talk soon, girl 💛

Bethany
